note: Built-in demo scenarios. Prices, inventory, and merchants are simulated.

scenarios.title: Budget campus kit
scenarios.description: A bag, stationery, and drinkware for everyday campus use with an IDR 250,000 budget and at most two merchants.

mission.goal: Build a minimalist everyday campus kit

scenarios.title: Remote workspace
scenarios.description: Desk accessories, supporting electronics, and drinkware for remote work with an IDR 750,000 budget.

mission.goal: Create a comfortable and organized remote workspace

scenarios.title: Budget daily essentials
scenarios.description: Snacks, drinkware, and personal-care items for daily activities with an IDR 100,000 budget.

mission.goal: Build a budget-friendly set of daily essentials

scenarios.title: Graduation gift
scenarios.description: A simple stationery and organizer gift, with an optional book and an IDR 200,000 budget.

mission.goal: Choose a thoughtful and useful graduation gift

scenarios.title: New-semester setup
scenarios.description: A bag, books, electronics, and desk accessories with an IDR 1,000,000 budget from at most three merchants.

mission.goal: Prepare all essentials for a new semester

scenarios.title: Infeasible mission example
scenarios.description: An intentionally insufficient budget that demonstrates infeasibility handling and constraint-relaxation suggestions.

mission.goal: Buy a power bank on a very limited budget
